MODAL.TITLE: WhatsApp Flows

SETTINGS.PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Register WhatsApp Cloud Flow IDs and schema metadata used by agents inside conversations.
SETTINGS.SUPPORTED_DESCRIPTION: These records stay scoped to this inbox. Published records with a provider Flow ID become available in the conversation Flow picker.
SETTINGS.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search flows by name, title, ID, status, or category
SETTINGS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add a Flow ID from Meta Flow Manager before agents can send it from conversations.
SETTINGS.NO_PROVIDER_ID: No provider Flow ID — not sendable yet
SETTINGS.CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Store the Meta Flow ID and optional local schema used by the conversation picker.
SETTINGS.EDIT_DESCRIPTION: Update the local registry record for this inbox.

ERRORS.FLOW_JSON_OBJECT: Flow JSON must be a JSON object.

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Delete WhatsApp Flow?
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: This removes {flow} from this inbox registry. Already sent messages and submitted replies stay in the conversation history.
